test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 76

questions.question: Rajesh and Rohit started a business with investments of ₹45,000 and ₹65,000 respectively at the beginning of a year. Determine the share of Rohit in that year's profit if the profit received by Rajesh as his share was ₹15,300.

A man purchased two varieties of apples, one at the rate of ₹2 for 3 apples, and the other at ₹6 per apple. He bought an equal number of apples of each variety and sold all the apples at ₹5 per apple. What was his percentage profit?
यदि (x − y) का 50% = (x + y) का 30% है, तो y, x का कितना प्रतिशत है?
At what rate (in percentage) per annum on simple interest will a sum of money be 3 times of itself in 8 years?
A person spends 68% of the income and saves the rest amount. If the expenditure is increased by 22.5% and savings decreased by 10%, then by what percentage does the income increase or decrease?

There are two sections A and B of a group, consisting of 22 and 44 students, respectively. If the average weight of section A is 40 kg and that of section B is 35 kg, find the average weight of the whole group (in kg). (Rounded off to two decimal places.)
A truck is moving at a speed of 100 km/hr. If its speed is reduced by 67%, the new speed of the truck (in km/hr) will be:

In a business, X invested 15% more than Y. Y invested 10% less than Z. If the total investment was ₹3,00,000, what is the approximate amount (in ₹) invested by Z?
Ravi began a business with ₹1,75,000. He was joined afterwards by Sanjay with ₹1,31,250. For how much period does Sanjay join if the profits at the end of the year are divided in the ratio of 4 : 1?
If a man bought 10 pencils for ₹3, and sold them at 5 pencils for ₹7, then the approximate gain percentage is _____%.
A man covers the first 120 km of his journey at 60 km/hr and the next 30 km of his journey at 10 km/hr. Find his average speed.

Ram and Mohan can do a piece of work in 16 days, while Mohan and Somesh can do the same work in 12 days. Somesh and Ram can do the same work in 24 days. They all work together for 8 days. How long will Somesh take to finish the remaining work?

Panchayat Samiti of a village took a decision to dig up two ponds in two places of a village. 250 workers dig up the first pond that is 50 m long, 35 m broad and 5.2 m deep in 18 days working 10 hours daily. How many days will be required to dig up another pond that is 65 m long, 40 m broad and 5.6 m deep by 300 workers working 8 hours daily?

A field is 50 m long and 30 m wide. A pit which is 12 m long, 8 m wide and 9 m deep has been dug out in one corner of the field. The earth taken out of it is evenly spread over the remaining part of the field. Find the rise in the level of the field (in cm; rounded off to 2 decimal places).
